indexing.physicalLines: One-based LF-delimited physical lines; the final split sentinel after the final LF is not a new physical source line. Preserve the final blank physical line.
indexing.byteOffsets: Zero-based absolute UTF-8 byte offsets with exclusive end. Never use UTF-16 code-unit offsets.
indexing.lineSha256: SHA-256 of exact line UTF-8 bytes excluding LF, including all other original characters.
indexing.sourceSpanSha256: SHA-256 of the exact specified byte slice.
indexing.canonicalPaths: Use the supplied role/path and source hash; do not infer identity from a filename.

assignment.draft: Independently extract all inserted source obligations and their retained-source/context/cross-reference effects from only these five sources.
assignment.review: Independently perform the same task without reading draft output, code/tests, candidate atoms, prior implementation analysis or adapter design.
assignment.reconciliation: Start only after both outputs freeze. A distinct reconciler compares both completed outputs and the governing source; authoritative old entry mapping is a later separate input, not part of either blind pass.

requiredOutputShape.inputs: Exact list of all source files actually read, including path, SHA256 and byte length; any unexpected input must be disclosed

independence.draftManifestReceived: Boolean actual fact; independent review must be false
independence.otherContributorOutputRead: Boolean actual fact; both independent-phase outputs must be false
independence.implementationOrTestsRead: Boolean actual fact; must be false

coverage.successorInsertionRanges: All seven exact current line ranges, totaling 193 lines
coverage.sourceRangesActuallyRead: Array of {role,startLine,endLine}; include every target and transitive governing passage actually used
coverage.unreadOrUnresolvedSourceDependencies: Explicit list; no silent complete claim

requiredOutputShape.lineClassifications: Array, one row for each of the 193 inserted lines: {successorLine,proposalLineOrNull,rawText,lineSha256,classification,reason,governingSourceReferences}. classification is NORMATIVE, BLANK, STRUCTURAL_HEADING, STRUCTURAL_TABLE or UNRESOLVED. A structural heading/table can still govern obligations; record its effect rather than discarding it. Closing inserted formatting blanks have proposalLineOrNull=null.
requiredOutputShape.obligations: Array of independently identified distinct duties/prohibitions: {localId,atomicKey,statement,requirementKind,primarySourceLocation:{role,startLine,endLine,lineSha256,controllingText},sourceSpans:[{startByte,endByte,text,sha256}],contextSourceLocations:[{role,startLine,endLine,lineSha256,controllingText}],conditions,expectedSourceMeaning,unresolvedIssues}. Do not allocate authoritative NREQ IDs or add owner/test/proof claims. primary lines are successor source; scope spans are exact source bytes on the primary line; additional required qualifiers are context references.
requiredOutputShape.sourceContexts: Array of {localId,sourceLocation,classification,reason,governedLocalObligationIds,exactGoverningSourceRanges}. classification is STRUCTURAL_REQUIREMENT_CONTEXT or HISTORICAL_NONNORMATIVE_CONTEXT only when justified; unresolved context is separate. Never broaden a range across inserted lines without an explicit semantic decision.
requiredOutputShape.retainedSourceImpacts: Array of {impactId,baseSourceLocations,successorSourceLocations,triggeringApprovedClauseReferences,disposition,priorMeaning,currentMeaning,addedOrChangedGovernors,reason,unresolvedIssues}. dispositions: PRESERVED_WITHOUT_NEW_CONTEXT, ADDED_REQUIRED_COMPONENT, ADDED_OR_CHANGED_GOVERNING_CONTEXT, CHANGED_PROPOSITION, UNRESOLVED. Identify effects by exact source occurrences; original atom IDs are not supplied to these blind passes and are mapped later by a distinct reconciler. Do not mark unexamined old material unaffected.
requiredOutputShape.crossReferenceInteractions: Array of {interactionId,referenceText,referenceSourceLocation,resolvedBaseSourceRanges,resolvedSuccessorSourceRanges,relationship,sourceMeaningInteraction,impactIds,unresolvedIssues}. Resolve every operative reference needed to interpret the approved clauses, including actual target/currentness/evidence authority and inherited limits.
requiredOutputShape.unresolvedFindings: Explicit array of source ambiguities, missing references or possible scope conflicts. Empty only after the bounded actual source pass finds none.

authorityLimits: The owner approved exact v4 for implementation and verification. Approval does not establish implementation or runtime proof.
Do not treat prior proposal review as the required independent atomic extraction.
Do not infer a fresh full-source review from this bounded amendment/impact pass.
Do not inspect any other file in the parent design directory. Ask for exact source passages if needed rather than reading implementation artifacts.
